title: Musician or band
summary: For musicians and bands: the newest release up top, the catalogue as cover art, tour dates with tickets, and every place to listen.

cards.purpose: The newest release and where to hear it.
Albums, EPs and singles with cover art, newest first.
Every place to listen and follow.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: What is your newest release, and where should people listen to it first?
slots.write: Heading = the release and its status (out now, out on a date); first button = Listen now to the link they choose.

slots.ask: Which releases should be listed? For each: the type, year and a link. You'll upload the cover art in the editor.
slots.write: tag = Single, EP or Album · year; title exactly as released; newest first. Alt text = a description of the cover art from them.

slots.ask: Do you have upcoming shows? For each: date, city, venue and ticket link.
slots.write: tag = date · city; title = venue; description only for notes such as support acts or sold out. Remove past dates.

slots.ask: Where can people listen and follow you? Paste the artist pages.
slots.write: Artist page URLs only; the app shows each platform's icon.

slots.ask: Who handles booking and press, and which address may be public?
slots.write: Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it. Agents' addresses only with the agent's agreement.
